candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 on /v1/orders and gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show the failing hop is payment, not inventory (reservations succeed 200).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side telemetry or logs; root cause within payment (config, saturation, dependency) is unobserved.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are fast (~50-60ms) and trace to order returning 502 after payment returns 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed. Gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). Bounded candidate is a payment-side server error surfaced through order; payment internals are unobserved.
